scripts.dev: powershell -Command "Start-Process npm -ArgumentList 'run dev' -WorkingDirectory './server'; Start-Process npm -ArgumentList 'run dev' -WorkingDirectory './client'"
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install && npx prisma generate
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
